 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Rajeev Ranjan, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Abhay Kumar Roy, Addl. Public Prosecut
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A,
494, 323 and of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that dispute between the parties has been resolved through the process of mediation vide mediation report dated 17.08.2023.
4. Learned A.P.P does not dispute with the contention made on behalf of the petitioner.

5. Considering the aforesaid fact that dispute between the parties has already been resolved, in the event of arrest or Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.4044 of 2023(3) dt.19-08-2023 surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court of Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Madhepura in connection with Complaint Case No. 759 of 2012, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Sanjeev Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191747139/
1 Procedure.
